meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Zec.6.10; also called Helem at Zec.6.14;
Another name of chel.day (חֶלְדַּי "Heldai" H2469G)
§ Helem = "strength" or "dream"
a returned exile in the time of Zechariah; also spelled 'Heldai'

elsewhere.note: The crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.
